00074 void PopupComponent::timerCallback()
00075 {
00076   if(Component::getNumCurrentlyModalComponents() > 0 && counter >= 0)
00077   {
00078     resetCounter();
00079   }
00080   else
00081   {
00082     counter--;    
00083     if(counter < 0)

00087     }

00111 void BufferProcess::add(Buffer const& buffer, UGen const& input, UGen const& graph, const int bufferID) throw()
00112 {
00113   ugen_assert(buffer.size() > 0);
00114   ugen_assert(buffer.getNumChannels() > 0);
00115   ugen_assert(input.getNumChannels() > 0);
00116   ugen_assert(graph.getNumChannels() > 0);
00117   
00118   const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00119   
00120   buffers.add(buffer);
00121   inputs.add(input);
00122   graphs.add(graph);
00123   ids.add(bufferID);
00124 }
00125 
00126 void BufferProcess::add(const int size, UGen const& graph, const int bufferID) throw()
00127 {
00128   ugen_assert(size > 0);
00129   ugen_assert(graph.getNumChannels() > 0);
00130   
00131   const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00132   
00133   buffers.add(Buffer::withSize(size, graph.getNumChannels(), false));
00134   inputs.add(UGen::getNull());
00135   graphs.add(graph);
00136   ids.add(bufferID);
00137 }

00139 
00140 void BufferProcess::run() throw()
00141 {
00142   while(threadShouldExit() == false)
00143   {
00144     Thread::yield();
00145     
00146     const ScopedLock sl(lock);
00147     
00148     int count = buffers.length();
00149     bool needClear = false;
00150     
00151     for(int i = 0; i < count; i++)
00152     {
00153       if(threadShouldExit() == true) break;
00154       
00155       needClear = true;
00156       
00157       Buffer buffer = buffers[i];
00158       
00159       if(inputs[i].isNull())
00160       {
00161         buffer.synthInPlace(graphs[i]);
00162         sendBuffer(buffer, 0.0, ids[i]);
00163       }
00164       else
00165       {
00166         Buffer result = buffer.process(inputs[i], graphs[i]);
00167         sendBuffer(result, 0.0, ids[i]);
00168       }
00169     }
00170     
00171     if(needClear)
00172     {
00173       buffers = ObjectArray<Buffer>();
00174       inputs = ObjectArray<UGen>();
00175       graphs = ObjectArray<UGen>();
00176       ids = IntArray();
00177     }
00178   }
00179 }
